title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #6

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How many verses does Surah Al-Falaq have? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 3
   C. 6
   D. 5

2. Which surah contains the words "You have your religion and I have mine"? (1 mark)
   A. An-Nasr
   B. Al-Masad
   C. Al-Ikhlas
   D. Al-Kafirun

3. What is a hadith? (1 mark)
   A. A saying, action or approval of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
   B. A chapter of the Qur'an
   C. A Muslim festival
   D. A type of prayer

4. What can someone say if they forget Bismillah at the start of the meal? (1 mark)
   A. Allahu Akbar
   B. Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu
   C. Astaghfirullah only
   D. Nothing

5. How often should a toothbrush be replaced? (1 mark)
   A. Never
   B. Every day
   C. Every ten years
   D. About every three months or when bristles bend

6. In the Prophet's teaching, before every prayer the siwak was (1 mark)
   A. Forbidden
   B. Required only for sick people
   C. Strongly encouraged but not made compulsory
   D. Compulsory on children only

7. What does "Ar-Rahman" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The All-Seeing
   B. The All-Hearing
   C. The Most Kind, whose mercy is for all
   D. The King

8. Which name reminds us that Allah sees us when we are alone? (1 mark)
   A. As-Salam
   B. Al-Basir
   C. Ar-Rahim
   D. Al-Malik

9. Why did Allah create angels? (1 mark)
   A. To rule over people
   B. To be worshipped
   C. To worship Him and carry out His orders
   D. To play

10. Who is called "Ar-Ruh al-Amin", the Trustworthy Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Israfil
   B. Mikail
   C. Raqib
   D. Jibril

11. Which two prophets showed obedience when Ibrahim was told in a dream to sacrifice? (1 mark)
   A. Musa and Harun
   B. Yusuf and Yaqub
   C. Ibrahim and Ismail
   D. Nuh and Hud

12. Yahya was the son of (1 mark)
   A. Zakariyya
   B. Dawud
   C. Musa
   D. Ibrahim

13. If there is solid matter of a najasa, what should you do first? (1 mark)
   A. Cover it
   B. Remove it
   C. Sprinkle perfume
   D. Ignore it

14. What should you do after cleaning a najasa? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore
   B. Sleep
   C. Eat immediately
   D. Wash your hands

15. Which water cannot be used to purify? (1 mark)
   A. Tap water
   B. Clean rain water
   C. Well water
   D. Water changed in colour, smell or taste by najasa

16. How far are the arms washed? (1 mark)
   A. Up to the shoulder
   B. Only the wrist
   C. Up to and including the elbows
   D. Only the palm

17. What do we say in ruku? (1 mark)
   A. Bismillah
   B. Alhamdulillah
   C. Subhana Rabbiyal Azim
   D. Subhana Rabbiyal A'la

18. What is tuma'ninah? (1 mark)
   A. Calmness in each position
   B. Ignoring order
   C. Loudness
   D. Speed

19. Which animal do people in northern Kenya commonly use to carry loads? (1 mark)
   A. Zebra
   B. Camel
   C. Hippo
   D. Monkey

20. What should you do if you find an injured bird? (1 mark)
   A. Ask an adult to help
   B. Play with it
   C. Kick it
   D. Ignore it

21. Why should we not pollute rivers? (1 mark)
   A. Only people use rivers
   B. Fish and other creatures live there
   C. Fish do not matter
   D. Rivers are ugly

22. Which of these is honest work? (1 mark)
   A. Gambling
   B. Farming
   C. Stealing
   D. Cheating

23. How can children show thanks to parents? (1 mark)
   A. Complain
   B. Compare them with others
   C. Ignore them
   D. Say thank you and make dua for them

24. What does Qur'an 66:6 tell believers? (1 mark)
   A. Protect yourselves and your families
   B. Ignore your family
   C. Travel far
   D. Sell everything

25. What did the Prophet say about the one who cuts family ties? (1 mark)
   A. He will not enter Paradise
   B. He is rewarded
   C. He is honoured
   D. Nothing

26. What does "'Alaq" refer to in Surah Al-Alaq? (1 mark)
   A. A pen
   B. A cave
   C. A mountain
   D. A clinging clot

27. What does "As-Siddiq" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The fast one
   B. The rich one
   C. The old one
   D. The truthful one who believes

28. What does "R.A." stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Read Allah
   B. Peace be upon him
   C. May Allah be pleased with him or her
   D. Rest at once

29. What did the Prophet do in the garden? (1 mark)
   A. Ate everything
   B. Fled to another land
   C. Made dua to Allah
   D. Cursed them

30. What is tolerance? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring
   B. Insulting
   C. Bearing with people who behave badly without hurting them
   D. Fighting

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain how the greeting "As-salamu alaykum" is connected to a name of Allah. (3 marks)

32. State two creatures of Allah in your environment. (2 marks)

33. Describe what the Prophet (S.A.W.) did every night before sleeping with Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Naas. (3 marks)

34. State two ways a child can earn or save money safely. (2 marks)

35. State three groups of people who deserve help. (3 marks)

36. Explain what "Al-Fatiha" means and why it has that name. (3 marks)

37. State three times when it is recommended to be in wudhu. (3 marks)

38. What does twahara mean and why is it important? (2 marks)

39. Why are Al-Falaq and An-Naas called the two surahs of seeking refuge? (3 marks)

40. Why do Muslims all over the world face the Qibla? (4 marks)

41. Explain tartib in swalah. (2 marks)

42. Plan a Muslim school sports day including at least five rules or activities. (5 marks)

43. What is an attribute of Allah? Give one example. (2 marks)

44. Explain the hadith "The upper hand is better than the lower hand". (3 marks)

45. Match each surah with one lesson: Al-Fatiha, Al-Kafirun, An-Nasr and Al-Ikhlas. (4 marks)

46. Describe what you should do when you enter your home. (4 marks)

47. Distinguish between a nabi and a rasul. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — 5
   Al-Falaq has five verses.

2. D — Al-Kafirun
   This is the last verse of Al-Kafirun.

3. A — A saying, action or approval of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
   Hadith records what the Prophet said, did or approved.

4. B — Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu
   The Prophet taught this for one who forgets.

5. D — About every three months or when bristles bend
   Worn bristles do not clean well.

6. C — Strongly encouraged but not made compulsory
   He said he would have ordered it if not hard.

7. C — The Most Kind, whose mercy is for all
   Ar-Rahman shows Allah's mercy to all creation.

8. B — Al-Basir
   Al-Basir sees everything.

9. C — To worship Him and carry out His orders
   Allah does not need them.

10. D — Jibril
   This title refers to Jibril.

11. C — Ibrahim and Ismail
   Both were ready to obey Allah.

12. A — Zakariyya
   Yahya was the son of Zakariyya.

13. B — Remove it
   Remove the substance first.

14. D — Wash your hands
   Wash hands with soap and water.

15. D — Water changed in colour, smell or taste by najasa
   Its purity has been lost.

16. C — Up to and including the elbows
   Qur'an 5:6 says to the elbows.

17. C — Subhana Rabbiyal Azim
   Glory to my Lord, the Most Great.

18. A — Calmness in each position
   Staying still for a moment.

19. B — Camel
   Camels carry loads in dry areas.

20. A — Ask an adult to help
   Get help from an adult.

21. B — Fish and other creatures live there
   Pollution harms creatures.

22. B — Farming
   Honest work is farming.

23. D — Say thank you and make dua for them
   Gratitude.

24. A — Protect yourselves and your families
   Families need guidance.

25. A — He will not enter Paradise
   A warning in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

26. D — A clinging clot
   Man was created from a clinging clot.

27. D — The truthful one who believes
   Abu Bakr's title.

28. C — May Allah be pleased with him or her
   Radiyallahu anhu.

29. C — Made dua to Allah
   He turned to Allah.

30. C — Bearing with people who behave badly without hurting them
   He did not curse them.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: As-Salam is Allah's name meaning the Source of Peace. The greeting is a prayer for peace and safety.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for As-Salam, 1 mark for meaning of the greeting, 1 mark for the link.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: Any two, for example a cow and a bird.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: He joined his hands, blew into them, recited the three surahs and wiped his body with his hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for blowing into the hands, 1 mark for the three surahs, 1 mark for wiping the body.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: Chores for a small reward with permission, and saving in a box or school scheme.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: People in debt, people who lost property through disaster, and the destitute.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: Al-Fatiha means The Opening. It is the first surah of the Qur'an and it opens every prayer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for first surah, 1 mark for opening the prayer.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Before prayer, before touching the Qur'an, before sleeping, before reciting Qur'an.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: Twahara means purity. It is a condition for prayer and other acts of worship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for importance.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Both begin with "Qul a'udhu", meaning "Say: I seek refuge". In them we ask Allah to protect us from harm.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the opening words, 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for protection.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah commanded it in the Qur'an (2:144). It unites Muslims and shows that we worship one Lord.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for command, 1 mark for the verse or Kaaba, 1 mark for unity, 1 mark for one Lord.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Doing the pillars in the correct order.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for order and 1 mark for an example.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: Bismillah at the start, modest kits, fair play, warm-up, stop for prayer, respect referees, greet teams, thank Allah at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid rule or activity, up to 5.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: A quality that describes Allah, for example Ar-Rahman, the Most Kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for a correct example.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: The giving hand is better than the receiving hand. A Muslim should try to work and give rather than depend on others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for giver better, 1 mark for work, 1 mark for the lesson.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: Al-Fatiha: praise Allah and ask for guidance; Al-Kafirun: stay firm in faith; An-Nasr: thank Allah when you succeed; Al-Ikhlas: Allah is One.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: Say Bismillah and the dua, greet with salaam, place shoes neatly, wash hands, speak kindly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four actions.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: A nabi is a prophet who receives revelation; a rasul is a prophet given a message or book to deliver.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
